chunks: Jamil narrated from Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who emancipated his slave at the time of his death while he had a debt, he said: “If the value of the slave is equal to what he owes and the like of it, his emancipation is valid; otherwise, it is not valid.”
ai.seo_question: Is freeing a slave at the time of death valid if the deceased still owes debts?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the emancipation of a slave by a dying debtor. The ruling indicates that such an emancipation is only valid when the slave’s value does not infringe upon the rights of creditors, showing the priority of debt obligations in financial law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3452 - Jamil narrated from Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who freed his slave at the time of his death while he was in debt.
Imam (as) said: "If the value of the slave equals the amount of his debt or more, the emancipation is valid. Otherwise, it is not valid."
